items.caption: Plant diagram of the heating circuit (pumps, valves, flow, temperatures) - modeled on building management system visualizations. Automatically finds all heat pump instances through the shared 'heatpump' contract (HeishaMon, WPHub) - no manual linking needed.

If the data source supplies no pump/valve/flow values (e.g. a plain WPHub installation without the HeishaMon add-on board), the tile shows only the basic values (electrical power) instead of an incomplete pipe diagram.
Neither HeishaMon nor WPHub? Under “Manual data connection” further down you can link your own existing variables to the same fields.

items.name: HookInfo
items.caption: IPSView/popup: the tile also runs as a standalone web page at http://<Symcon-IP>:3777%s (auto-refresh every 30 s). In IPSView, place a WebView element on a popup page and enter this URL. Note: WebHooks can be reached on the local network without logging in.

items.name: StandaloneEnabled
items.caption: Enable standalone web page for browser and IPSView

Only needed if the tile is to run as its own web page (browser, IPSView). If you only use the tile in the WebFront, you can switch this off: then no WebHook is registered and access from outside is removed. Switching it off removes the existing entry.

✨ Detail (start the tour yourself at any time, 01.09.2026): a clearly visible “?” button at the bottom left of the tile shows the introduction tour again at any time - regardless of the saved “already seen” status. Intended for shared instances (e.g. a demo/showcase instance with one shared login for all visitors).

✨ Detail (simulation hydraulically consistent, 03.09.2026): in the simulated hot water mode both heating circuits stand still - the three-way valve sends the entire flow into the tank, so a heating circuit running at the same time would be physically impossible. The flow then shows the higher tank charging temperature instead of the heating circuit temperature.

✨ Detail (heating element only where it belongs, 03.09.2026): in the simulation the heating element is off by default and only appears in defrost mode - a booster heater in cooling mode would be technically wrong, and in heating or hot water mode it is the exception for a healthy system.

✨ Detail (even without outdoor air, 10.09.2026): besides split/monoblock, the system type behind the double arrow now also offers “Brine/water (borehole)”, “Brine/water (ground collector)” and “Water/water (well)” - instead of an outdoor unit, the diagram then draws a plain exchanger box with the matching underground piping (vertical borehole, flat surface collector or a pair of intake/return wells), without the fan and defrost mode that do not exist there. Two new optional data points for the source inlet/return temperature can be linked manually; heat exchanger, indoor unit, buffer/DHW tank and heating circuits stay unchanged.

✨ Detail (no current measurement, 13.09.2026): if the heat pump source reports the time of its last real measurement (e.g. WPHub from contract 1.13) and that is more than 15 minutes ago, a yellow note “No current measurement since …” appears above the diagram and the diagram is dimmed - the values in it are then outdated.

For heat pumps without HeishaMon/WPHub: link your own existing variables (e.g. from a Modbus module or your own scripts) to the fields of this diagram. Can be used in addition to automatic detection - not only as a replacement.
